actions.label: Delete the next character
actions.caption: ctrl+d deletes the space after name. Fix the character under the search cursor without retyping the whole query.

actions.label: Delete the previous character
actions.caption: backspace deletes the e before the cursor. Correct the text you just typed while keeping the rest of the query.

actions.label: Paste search text
actions.caption: ctrl+a ctrl+k clears the line; paste owner into it. Reuse a copied key or value as your search instead of typing it.

actions.label: Insert a space
actions.caption: ctrl+a ctrl+k clears the line; type owner, space, then name. A space lets the search text include a phrase.

actions.label: Remove the rest of the line
actions.caption: ctrl+k cuts from the cursor to the end. Keep name and replace the trailing search text.

actions.label: Remove text before the cursor
actions.caption: ctrl+u cuts from the start to the cursor. Keep the trailing text when the beginning of your query is wrong.

actions.label: Cut the previous word
actions.caption: ctrl+w cuts the word before the cursor. Remove one search term while leaving the following term intact.

actions.label: Cut the next word
actions.caption: alt+d cuts forward by a word. Replace the next search term without touching the first one.

actions.label: Cut backward by a word
actions.caption: alt+backspace cuts the preceding word. Use this alternative word-delete key when correcting a longer query.

actions.label: Move left in the query
actions.caption: ctrl+b moves the search cursor left one character. Position it precisely before deleting or inserting text.

actions.label: Go to the end of the query
actions.caption: ctrl+e moves the cursor to the end. Add another term without stepping across each character.

actions.label: Go to the start of the query
actions.caption: ctrl+a moves the cursor to the start. Replace or extend the first term directly.

actions.label: Move right in the query
actions.caption: ctrl+f moves the search cursor right one character. Skip past the space before editing the next word.

actions.label: Move forward by a word
actions.caption: alt+f moves to the next word boundary. Navigate a long search query in larger steps.

actions.label: Move backward by a word
actions.caption: alt+b moves back to the preceding word. Return to the term you want to correct.

actions.label: Restore cut search text
actions.caption: ctrl+w cuts name; ctrl+y puts it back literally. Recover a term you removed while editing the query.

actions.label: Select part of the query
actions.caption: ctrl+v starts a character selection; right extends it. Select just the text you want to replace or copy.

actions.label: Read matching values
actions.caption: Clear the line, type name, then enter moves to the Results view. Read the matching values beside their paths.

actions.label: Cancel this search
actions.caption: esc leaves the search line and restores the document view. Use it when the query is unfinished or no longer useful.

actions.label: Try fuzzy matching
actions.caption: tab changes substring search to fuzzy search. Find a key even when you remember only some of its letters.

actions.label: Use jq in the search line
actions.caption: Clear the text and type .items; shift+tab switches backward to jq and runs it. Turn a search into an extraction without leaving the viewer.

actions.label: Return within the text window
actions.caption: pgup addresses the page surface; this mapping scrolls with ctrl+u. After moving down, use the editor motion to return to earlier lines.

actions.label: Choose the right scroll target
actions.caption: pgdown scrolls page surfaces. This mapping is an editor window, so ctrl+d moves its text instead. Use the window motion when a page key stays put.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
